memberdef.name: PT_UDP_BLOCK_READ
memberdef.initializer: do { \ while (1) { \ if (!syn_udp_pt_args_valid((pt), (task), (sock), (buf), (bytes_read))) { \ return PT_EXITED; \ } \ (sock)->blocked_task = (task); \ syn_port_enter_critical(); \ if ((task)->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY) { \ (task)->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED; \ SYN_PT_STATE_BARRIER(); \ } \ syn_port_exit_critical(); \ if ((sock)->dgram_count > 0U || (sock)->rx_len > 0U || !(sock)->is_bound) { \ syn_port_enter_critical(); \ if ((task)->state == (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_BLOCKED) { \ (task)->state = (uint8_t)SYN_TASK_READY; \ } \ syn_port_exit_critical(); \ break; \ } \ PT_PASS(pt); \ } \ (sock)->blocked_task = NULL; \ (void)syn_udp_recv((sock), (buf), (max_len), (bytes_read), (src_ip), (src_port)); \ } while (0)
